term: Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act
definition: The Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act, also referred to as SB-53, is a 2025 California law which mandates increased transparency for companies building artificial intelligence.
details: SB-53 is primarily focused on assessing and reducing potential catastrophic risks from AI, and is the first bill addressing such risks to be passed into law in America. The bill requires companies to create publicly accessible documents assessing potential "catastrophic risk[s]" from their AI models, as well as publishing documentation on how the model incorporates national and international safety standards. SB-53 also sets up whistleblower protections and procedures for alerting the government to a "critical safety incident".
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Think of it as the quiet rule that a tool should be useful without being dangerous. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” And that is Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
